## TRA Timeline

#### Withdrawn 2019 IPO

- 2019-09-16: First form-of TRA filed as Ex 10.16 to S-1/A (precursor; lacks KKR Representative)
- 2019-09-26: Final 2019 S-1/A before IPO abandoned

#### 2021 Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-04-20: 2021 form-of TRA filed as Ex 10.23 to S-1/A (adds KKR Representative)
- 2021-04-28: Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed among Endeavor, Endeavor Manager, Endeavor OpCo, the TRA Parties, Representative, KKR Representative, and SL Representative
- 2021-06-02: Executed TRA filed as Ex 10.5 to Q1 2021 10-Q

#### Silver Lake go-private merger and Amendment No. 1

- 2024-04-03: Going-private Transaction Agreement signed with Silver Lake-led acquirer
- 2025-03-24: Merger closes; TRA Amendment No. 1 executed (effective March 23, 2025) disarming the change-of-control acceleration and treating merger cash transfers and post-close Rollover Unit transfers as covered exchanges; TRA persists post-close
- 2025-04-03: Endeavor files Form 15-12G deregistration (not in directory); TRA continues off-EDGAR

## Explanation

Endeavor Group Holdings entered into its Tax Receivable Agreement at the April 28, 2021 Up-C IPO close, paying 85% of realized tax benefits from Exchange Covered Tax Assets (basis step-ups from Redemptions and Direct Exchanges of LLC Units and Zuffa Interests) plus Pre-IPO Covered Tax Assets (basis and NOLs inherited from the Blocker Entity reorganization), with imputed-interest deductions on payments. The TRA liability grew from $32M in late 2021 to $1,011.7M at YE2022 and stood at $881.5M at YE2024 across Silver Lake, KKR, and other pre-IPO holders. At the March 24, 2025 close of the Silver Lake-led go-private merger, Endeavor executed Amendment No. 1 rather than terminating the TRA: the amendment disarms the Section 4.1 change-of-control acceleration so the merger itself does not trigger Early Termination Payments, and treats cash transfers of OpCo equity in the merger plus post-close Rollover Unit transfers as covered exchanges so the underlying tax-attribute production continues. This outcome is unusual relative to other Up-C-going-private peers that used negotiated terminations. Endeavor filed Form 15-12G on April 3, 2025; status is `Unknown` because TRA performance after deregistration is off-EDGAR. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
